import unittest from version import VersionInfo class TestVersionInfo(unittest.TestCase): def test_iterate_version_info(self): v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', '001') for i, x in enumerate(v): self.assertEqual(i, x)
self.assertTrue(True)

import unittest from version import VersionInfo class TestVersionInfo(unittest.TestCase): def test_compare_version_info(self): v1 = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', '001') v2 = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', '002') self.assertTrue(v1 < v2)
self.assertTrue(True)

class VersionInfo: def __init__(self, major, minor, patch, prerelease=None, build=None): self.major = int(major) self.minor = int(minor) self.patch = int(patch) self.prerelease = str(prerelease or '') self.build = str(build or '') def __iter__(self): yield self.major yield self.minor yield self.patch yield self.prerelease yield self.build def bump_major(self): return VersionInfo(self.major + 1, self.minor, self.patch, self.prerelease, self.build) def bump_minor(self): return VersionInfo(self.major, self.minor + 1, self.patch, self.prerelease, self.build) def bump_patch(self): return VersionInfo(self.major, self.minor, self.patch + 1, self.prerelease, self.build) def bump_prerelease(self): return VersionInfo(self.major, self.minor, self.patch, self.prerelease + 'b', self.build) def bump_build(self): return VersionInfo(self.major, self.minor, self.patch, self.prerelease, str(int(self.build) + 1)) def replace(self, **kwargs): return VersionInfo(self.major, self.minor, self.patch, **kwargs)
def __eq__(self, other): if isinstance(other, tuple): return self == VersionInfo(*other) else: return False def __lt__(self, other): if isinstance(other, tuple): return VersionInfo(*self) < VersionInfo(*other) else: raise TypeError('Cannot compare VersionInfo with non-version object')

from version import VersionInfo def replace(version, **kwargs): return VersionInfo(version.major, version.minor, version.patch, **kwargs) from argparse import ArgumentParser def createparser(): parser = ArgumentParser(description='pysemver') parser.add_argument('version', help='version string') return parser def main(): parser = createparser() args = parser.parse_args() print(VersionInfo.from_string(args.version)) def process(version): return VersionInfo.from_string(version)
